evidence_scope: one named OpenAI model-provider configuration operating authored local HTTP/SQLite services; not production-service evidence or a multi-agent coordination study
primary_contrast: FA-MAS minus feature-matched within the named OpenAI configuration
analysis_unit: paired task-policy trajectory within the named model-provider configuration
uncertainty: cluster-resampled descriptive intervals by authored service-fault family; 16 authored clusters
multiplicity: Holm across three supplementary exact cluster-sign randomization tests; conditional on cluster exchangeability
stopping_rule: retain every launched episode, including provider failures; stop before next episode if global call/token/budget limit is reached or after 3 consecutive provider failures
exclusions: none after launch; do not rerun failures or budget stops in the confirmatory set
held_out_rule: CI and development diagnostics use development tasks only; a passed preflight report and exact source/configuration lock are required before confirmatory execution
registration_status: local protocol prepared; not independently preregistered
